raw.query: SELECT run_id, handoff_gbps, handoff_p99_ms, encoder_delay_p99_ms, handoff_alone_violates_sla FROM provenance.v_fabric_sensitivity WHERE run_id IN ('aggregate44:fc_p90_L30', 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4') ORDER BY handoff_gbps DESC;
raw.observed: Baseline 25 Gbps (aggregate44:fc_p90_L30): handoff p99 272.001 ms, encoder-delay p99 588.37 ms. Sensitivity 6.25 Gbps representing 4x payload (aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4): handoff p99 1087.406 ms, encoder-delay p99 1403.774 ms, handoff_alone_violates_sla = true.
raw.claimed: Handoff: single-stream ~1.6MB/image; 4x payload on 25Gbps raises p99 handoff 272->1,087ms, encoder p99 1,404ms (SLA violation).
raw.evidence: The v_fabric_sensitivity view perfectly validates the numbers. Single-stream payload (~1.6 MB/img) is analytically derived from 196 tokens * 4096 hidden size * 2 bytes (bf16) = ~1.606 MB. A 4x payload on a 25 Gbps link is mathematically equivalent to a 1x payload on a 6.25 Gbps link by transmission linearity (explicitly documented in results-ledger.md). At 6.25 Gbps, handoff p99 rises to 1087.406 ms, and encoder delay p99 to 1403.774 ms, violating the 1,000 ms SLA from transfer alone.
